heading: AI plan & billing
subheadingCatalog: A fixed monthly price for everyday AI use. Anything a plan doesn't cover keeps using your credits.
subheadingManage: Your AI plan, renewals, autopay and tax invoices.

catalog.title: Choose an AI plan
catalog.empty: No plans are available for your institute right now.

footnotes.fairUse: Unlimited means unlimited within fair use. Beyond a fair-use limit, or with a model outside the plan, use is charged from your credits.
footnotes.uncovered: Anything a plan doesn't cover keeps using your credits. Prices are shown before GST; the total includes GST.

checkout.title: Subscribe to {{plan}}
checkout.startsOnPayment: Starts when your payment is received and renews every {{period}}.
checkout.anchorNote: Paying late never shortens a period: your renewal date is set when the first payment clears.
checkout.upgradeToday: Pay {{amount}} today for the rest of this period (until {{date}}). The new plan starts as soon as the payment clears.
checkout.quoteLoading: Working out the amount for the rest of this period…
checkout.quoteFailed: We couldn't work out the upgrade amount. Please try again in a moment.
checkout.supplierLine: You'll pay {{supplier}} securely via Razorpay. Your tax invoice will be issued by {{legal}}.
checkout.confirmingHint: This usually takes a few seconds.
checkout.slow: This is taking longer than usual. You can close this window: we'll email you when the payment is confirmed, and the plan will show here.
checkout.successBody: Your AI plan is active. The tax invoice is below and has been emailed to your billing address.

autopay.title: Autopay
autopay.explain: Renew automatically with UPI Autopay or a card mandate. You'll get a notice at least 24 hours before each charge, and you can turn autopay off at any time.
autopay.ceilingNote: Autopay works for renewals up to {{amount}} per payment. Without autopay you'll get a payment link before each renewal.
autopay.aboveCeiling: This plan costs more than {{amount}} per renewal, so renewals use a payment link instead of autopay.
autopay.mobileHint: Your bank or UPI app sends autopay notices to this number.
autopay.mobileInvalid: Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.
autopay.setUpNote: You'll authorise a refundable ₹1 payment to register the mandate. Future renewals are then charged automatically.
autopay.turnedOff: Autopay is off. You'll get a payment link before your next renewal.
autopay.returned: Thanks. Autopay can take a minute to show as active.

billing.title: GST details for your tax invoice
billing.description: Add your GSTIN to claim input tax credit. Leave it blank if your institute isn’t GST registered.
billing.savedHint: Saved from your last purchase. Edit if it has changed.
billing.futureOnly: Changes apply to future invoices only. Invoices already issued keep the details they were issued with.

errors.stateRequired: Select your state so the correct GST (CGST/SGST or IGST) is applied
errors.legalNameRequired: Enter the legal name to print on the tax invoice

manage.pendingBody: Your plan starts as soon as the payment is received.
manage.dueBody: Your renewal of {{amount}} is due on {{date}}.
manage.overdueBody: Payment of {{amount}} is overdue. Plan benefits are paused and AI use is charged from your credits until you pay. The plan ends on {{date}} if it stays unpaid.
manage.debitScheduled: {{amount}} will be charged by autopay on {{date}}.
manage.cancelledNote: Your plan won't renew. You keep it until {{date}}; after that AI use is charged from your credits.
manage.linkRenewalNote: Autopay is off, so we'll email a payment link 7 days before each renewal.
manage.anchorNote: Paying a renewal late doesn't move your renewal date.
manage.resumeDone: Your plan will renew as usual.

confirm.cancelBody: You keep {{plan}} until {{date}}. After that, AI use is charged from your credits. There are no refunds for the current period.
confirm.resumeBody: Your plan will renew on {{date}} as usual.
confirm.autopayOffBody: Renewals will no longer be charged automatically. We'll email a payment link before each renewal instead.

downgrade.title: Switch to {{plan}} at renewal?
downgrade.body: You keep your current plan until {{date}}. {{plan}} starts from your next renewal, at its price. Nothing is charged or refunded now.

contact.title: Talk to {{brand}}
contact.body: This plan change has to be set up by {{brand}}. Get in touch with them and they'll arrange it.
contact.bodyEmail: This plan change has to be set up by {{brand}}. Write to {{email}} and they'll arrange it.

invoices.title: Tax invoices and credit notes
invoices.popoverTitle: AI plan invoices and credit notes
invoices.empty: Tax invoices for your AI plan will appear here.
invoices.loadFailed: Could not load invoices. Please try again later.
invoices.downloadFailed: Could not download the PDF. Please try again.

entry.promoBody: A fixed monthly price for everyday AI use.
entry.lowCredit: Running low on credits? An AI plan covers everyday AI use for a fixed monthly price.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was charged. Please try again.
errors.paymentFailed: The payment was not completed. Nothing was charged.
errors.linkUnavailable: We couldn't start the payment. Nothing was charged. Please try again.
errors.ALREADY_SUBSCRIBED: You already have an AI plan. Change it from the plan details instead.
errors.NOT_OFFERED: This plan is no longer available.
errors.BUYER_STATE_REQUIRED: Select your state so the correct GST is applied.
errors.CURRENCY_NOT_SUPPORTED: AI plans can only be bought in Indian rupees right now.
errors.RETURN_URL_NOT_ALLOWED: Payments can't be started from this address. Open the admin from your usual address and try again.
errors.CONTACT_SALES: This change has to be set up by {{brand}}. Get in touch with them.
errors.PAY_RENEWAL_FIRST: Pay your renewal first, then you can upgrade.
errors.OPEN_UPGRADE_EXISTS: An upgrade payment is already open. Complete it or wait for it to expire.
errors.STOREFRONT_OFF: AI plans aren't available for your institute right now.
errors.PAYMENTS_DISABLED: Plan payments are paused right now. Please try again later.
errors.AUTOPAY_DISABLED: Autopay isn't available right now. Turn it off to pay by link.
errors.AUTOPAY_UNAVAILABLE: Autopay isn't available for this payment. Turn it off to pay by link, or check the billing email and mobile number.
errors.NO_SUBSCRIPTION: There is no AI plan to change.
errors.CONFLICT: Something changed in the meantime. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.DEBIT_IN_PROGRESS: An autopay payment for this renewal is in progress. Try again once it has gone through (usually within a day).
errors.BUYER_ADDRESS_REQUIRED: Add the billing name and address: they are printed on the GST invoice.
